title.en: The Doctor in the High Hat

introduction.zh: 帕德尔比的人都认识那位戴高礼帽的杜立德医生，见面总会说「他是个聪明人」。可这位人人敬重的医生，家里的食品间住着兔子，钢琴里住着白鼠。一个正经医生，家里怎么住满了动物？
introduction.en: Everyone in Puddleby knows the Doctor in his high hat. “He’s a clever man,” they say. But his small house is full of animals: rabbits in the food cupboard, white mice in the piano. Why would a proper doctor live like that?

sentences: 从前，很多很多年以前——那时我们的祖父还是小孩子——有一位医生，名叫杜立德，约翰·杜立德，医学博士。
「M.D.」的意思是，他是一位正统的医生，懂得非常多。

hints.zh: 医学博士（Doctor of Medicine）的缩写，说明他是正经挂牌的医生。
hints.en: Short for Doctor of Medicine: he was a properly qualified doctor.

sentences: 他住在一个叫「沼泽边的帕德尔比」的小镇上。
镇上的人，无论老少，都一眼就能认出他。
每当他戴着高礼帽走上街头，大家都会说：「医生来了！他可是个聪明人。」
狗和孩子都会跑上来跟在他身后；就连住在教堂钟楼里的乌鸦也会叫几声，点点头。

hints.zh: 帕德尔比，全名「沼泽边的帕德尔比」，故事发生的小镇。
hints.en: Puddleby-on-the-Marsh: the little town by the marsh where the story is set.

hints.zh: 凭长相、一眼认出；knew him well by sight 就是「一见就认得他」。
hints.en: From his appearance: they knew his face at once.

hints.zh: 高礼帽，旧时绅士出门戴的正式帽子。
hints.en: A tall formal hat worn out of doors by gentlemen of the time.

hints.zh: 人们（folks = people）。
hints.en: People; folks is a colloquial word for people.

sentences: 他住在镇子边上，房子很小；花园却很大，有宽阔的草坪、石凳，还有垂柳低低地垂下来。
他的姐姐萨拉·杜立德替他管家；不过花园是医生自己打理的。
他非常喜欢动物，养了许多种宠物。
除了花园尽头池塘里的金鱼，他还在食品间养兔子，在钢琴里养白鼠，在放床单的柜子里养松鼠，在地窖里养刺猬。
他还养了一头母牛和它的小牛，一匹二十五岁的瘸腿老马，还有鸡、鸽子、两只小羊，以及许多别的动物。
但他最喜欢的宠物是鸭子达布达布、狗吉普、小猪咕咕、鹦鹉波利尼西亚和猫头鹰图图。

hints.zh: 放床单、毛巾和亚麻织物的柜子。
hints.en: The cupboard where bed linen and towels are kept.

hints.zh: 达布达布，医生的鸭子。
hints.en: Dab-Dab, the Doctor's duck.

hints.zh: 吉普，医生的狗。
hints.en: Jip, the Doctor's dog.

hints.zh: 咕咕，医生的宠物小猪。
hints.en: Gub-Gub, the Doctor's baby pig.

hints.zh: 波利尼西亚，医生的鹦鹉。
hints.en: Polynesia, the Doctor's parrot.

hints.zh: 图图，医生的猫头鹰。
hints.en: Too-Too, the Doctor's owl.

quiz.question: What do people say when the Doctor walks down the street?
options: “There goes the Doctor! He’s a clever man.”

feedback.zh: 原文说他一上街，大家就说「医生来了！他是个聪明人」，狗和孩子都跟在后面。
feedback.en: The text says everyone would say “There goes the Doctor! He’s a clever man,” and the dogs and children followed him.

quiz.question: Where does the Doctor keep his rabbits?

feedback.zh: 兔子在食品间；白鼠在钢琴里，松鼠在放床单的柜子里，刺猬在地窖里。
feedback.en: The rabbits live in the pantry; the mice are in the piano, the squirrel in the linen closet and the hedgehog in the cellar.

grammar.excerpt: whenever he walked down the street in his high hat everyone would say

focus.zh: would say 讲过去反复发生的事：每次他上街，大家都会这么说，不是「将会说」。
focus.en: Would say does not mean the future here: it describes what people said again and again in the past.

introduction.zh: 姐姐萨拉替他管家，受够了满屋的动物。一位来看风湿的老太太坐到了沙发上睡觉的刺猬身上，从此再不上门。萨拉终于忍不住，把话挑明：再这样下去，谁还肯来找你看病？
introduction.en: His sister Sarah keeps house and has had enough of the animals. An old lady with rheumatism sits on the sleeping hedgehog and never comes back. At last Sarah speaks her mind: who will still come to the Doctor if things go on like this?

sentences: 姐姐过去常常为这些动物发牢骚，说它们把屋子弄得乱七八糟。
有一天，一位患风湿病的老太太来看病，一屁股坐在沙发上睡觉的刺猬身上；从那以后她再也没来找过他，而是每个星期六坐车跑十英里，去另一个镇奥克森索普看别的医生。

hints.zh: 奥克森索普，十英里外的另一个镇子。
hints.en: Oxenthorpe, another town ten miles away.

2.core: she sat on the hedgehog and never came to see him any more, but drove every Saturday all the way to Oxenthorpe

parts.text: when an old lady with rheumatism came to see the Doctor
parts.zh: when 从句交代时间：一位患风湿的老太太来看病时。
parts.en: The when-clause sets the time: an old lady with rheumatism came to see the Doctor.

parts.text: who was sleeping on the sofa
parts.zh: who 从句修饰 the hedgehog：刺猬正睡在沙发上。
parts.en: The who-clause describes the hedgehog: it was asleep on the sofa.

parts.zh: 同位语补充 Oxenthorpe：十英里外的另一个镇子。
parts.en: An appositive explains Oxenthorpe: another town ten miles off.

parts.zh: 不定式说明她跑那么远的目的：去看别的医生。
parts.en: The to-infinitive gives her purpose: to see a different doctor.

order.zh: 先把时间从句「有一天……来看病」放在前面，再说她坐到刺猬身上，最后用 but 引出她此后的做法：再也不来，改去十英里外的奥克森索普。
order.en: The time clause comes first, then what she sat on, then but introduces what she did afterwards: never return, and go to Oxenthorpe instead.

note.zh: 先找到主句的 sat、never came 和 drove；who 从句不是谓语，drove 与 sat、came 并列。
note.en: Find the main verbs sat, never came and drove; the who-clause is not a verb.

sentences: 后来，他的姐姐萨拉·杜立德走到他面前，说：
「约翰，你屋里养着这么些动物，还指望病人上门来看病吗？
好医生才会让诊室里塞满刺猬和老鼠呢！
这已经是这些动物赶走的第四位客人了。
詹金斯乡绅和教区牧师都说，不管病得多重，他们再也不会靠近你的房子。
我们一天比一天穷。
你再这样下去，体面人家谁也不会找你当医生了。」

hints.target: It’s a fine doctor would have his parlor full of hedgehogs and mice!
hints.zh: 萨拉的挖苦话：好医生才会让诊室里塞满刺猬和老鼠呢——意思是「哪有这样的医生」。
hints.en: Sarah is being sarcastic: a fine doctor indeed, who fills his parlour with hedgehogs and mice.

hints.zh: 人物、客人；这里带点夸张，指来看病的体面人。
hints.en: A person — here used a little pompously for a well-off patient.

hints.zh: 詹金斯乡绅，当地有地位的乡绅。
hints.en: Squire Jenkins: the local squire, a man of standing in the district.

hints.zh: 教区牧师。
hints.en: The parson: the priest of the parish.

hints.zh: 体面人、上流人家；萨拉指的是有钱有地位的主顾。
hints.en: The “best people”: the well-off families Sarah wants as patients.

sentences: 「可我喜欢动物，胜过喜欢那些『体面人』。」医生说。
「你真是荒唐。」姐姐说完，走出了房间。

quiz.question: Why does the old lady never come back to the Doctor?
options: She sat on the sleeping hedgehog.
The Doctor was too busy to see her.

feedback.zh: 原文说她一屁股坐在沙发上睡觉的刺猬身上，从此再没上门，宁可每个星期六坐车去十英里外的奥克森索普。
feedback.en: The text says she sat on the hedgehog asleep on the sofa, and after that drove all the way to Oxenthorpe every Saturday instead.

quiz.question: What does Sarah say will happen if the Doctor keeps the animals?
options: No fine people will come to him as patients.
The animals will eat his garden.

feedback.zh: 萨拉最后撂下话：再这样下去，体面人家谁也不会找他当医生了。
feedback.en: Sarah ends by telling him that if he goes on like this, none of the best people will have him for a doctor.

grammar.excerpt: His sister used to grumble about all these animals

focus.zh: used to grumble 表示过去常常抱怨，现在不一定如此；used to 后面跟动词原形。
focus.en: Used to grumble describes a habit in the past, not necessarily now; used to takes the base verb.

introduction.zh: 病人一个接一个不来了，只剩那个一年只在圣诞节病一次的卖猫食的人。动物却越养越多，钱越花越快。医生开始卖东西：钢琴，还有礼拜天穿的棕色西装。下一件要卖的会是什么？
introduction.en: One patient after another stops coming, until only the cat’s-meat man is left, and he falls ill just once a year at Christmas. The animals multiply and the money runs out. The Doctor starts selling things: his piano, then his brown Sunday suit. What will he have to sell next?

sentences: 日子一天天过去，医生的动物越来越多，上门看病的人却越来越少。
到最后，他一个病人也没有了——只剩下那个卖猫食的人，他倒不在乎屋里有什么动物。
可卖猫食的人不太有钱，一年只病一次——就在圣诞节前后。那时他会给医生六便士，买一瓶药。

hints.zh: 卖猫食的人，走街串巷卖马肉、猫食的小贩。
hints.en: The cat's-meat man: a street seller who sold meat for cats and dogs.

hints.zh: 六便士，英国旧币制的小银币，当时是很少的一点钱。
hints.en: Sixpence: a small silver coin in the old British money, very little even then.

sentences: 一年六便士，在那些久远的年月也不够过日子；要不是医生在存钱盒里攒了点钱，后来会怎样，谁也说不准。

hints.zh: 存钱盒、储蓄罐。
hints.en: A money-box where he kept his savings.

sentences: 他还不断添置新的宠物；养它们当然要花不少钱。
他攒下的钱越来越少。
后来他卖掉了钢琴，让白鼠住进五斗柜的抽屉。
可卖钢琴的钱也渐渐花光了，于是他又卖掉礼拜天穿的棕色西装，日子越过越穷。

hints.zh: 五斗柜、带抽屉的柜子；不是「办公室」。
hints.en: A chest of drawers, not an office.

sentences: 如今他戴着高礼帽上街，人们会互相说：「约翰·杜立德医学博士来了！
想当年，他是整个英格兰西南部最有名的医生——你看看他现在——一个钱也没有，袜子上全是窟窿！」

hints.zh: 英格兰西南部地区。
hints.en: The West Country: the south-west of England.

sentences: 可狗、猫和孩子们仍旧跑过来，跟着他穿过镇子——跟他有钱的时候一模一样。

quiz.question: Why does the Doctor sell his piano?
options: He needs money for food and for his animals.
He wants to buy a better one.

feedback.zh: 一年六便士不够生活，他只能靠积蓄；动物越养越多，钱越花越快，只好卖东西换钱。
feedback.en: Sixpence a year was not enough to live on, so he lived on his savings; feeding more animals cost more, and he began to sell things.

quiz.question: What do the animals and children do now that the Doctor is poor?
options: They still follow him through the town.

feedback.zh: 狗、猫和孩子仍旧跟着他走，跟他有钱的时候一样；变的只是大人们对他的议论。
feedback.en: The dogs, cats and children still run after him, just as they did when he was rich; only the grown-ups’ talk has changed.

grammar.excerpt: went on becoming poorer and poorer

focus.zh: poorer and poorer 用两个比较级表示程度不断加深：越来越穷；本段的 more and more、less and less 同理。
focus.en: Poorer and poorer joins two comparatives with and to show a change that keeps growing; more and more and less and less work the same way.
